what_they_do: Qued is a cloud-based platform that automates freight appointment scheduling for trucking and logistics operations, using AI (including AI voice) to book and manage dock appointments for carriers, brokers, and shippers. It replaces the manual work of scheduling load appointments by phone, email, web portal, and EDI, and integrates directly with TMS systems like McLeod so appointment confirmations flow straight into existing dispatch workflows.
theme_fit_rationale: Qued embeds directly into the high-frequency, high-stakes conversations (phone calls, emails, portal messages) where freight appointments are actually booked, matching Theme 8's use case of 'trucking and logistics dispatch' built on conversational data, and it is turning that into a system of record for appointment status. Secondary fit with Theme 2 because the value also comes from coordinating across systems (TMS/McLeod, carrier, broker, shipper dock) that previously required manual human handoffs.
workflow_artifacts: phone, email, and web-portal appointment bookings

recent_signals.summary: Qued partnered with Don Hummer Trucking, a 70-year family carrier; platform has confirmed 10,000+ appointments for them with a 98.8% success rate on email scheduling.
Qued partnered with Prime Inc. (North America's largest refrigerated carrier); Prime's Refrigerated Division has booked 23,000+ appointments through Qued with booking time down as much as 90%.
